name: dairy-free swap that wasn't
found_by: support drill (see drill.md) - complaint: 'it recommended a dairy-free substitution that wasn't dairy-free, sometime last week'
root_cause: Retrieval: top-3 hybrid search for a dairy-free question returns method steps, not the allergen line ('Allergens: Dairy (ghee)') or the full ingredient list, so the model never sees that its answer is dairy. Prompt: v1 has no rule that ghee/butter are dairy and lets the model treat 'dairy not mentioned in my 3 chunks' as 'recipe is dairy-free'.

cases.source: verbatim question from the bad trace; v1 answered 'Use ghee to fry the cashews. [chunk_0df1a3f4]'
cases.query: I'm cooking Ven Pongal for a dairy-free guest. What can I fry the cashews in instead of butter?

why_each_check.dairy_safe: the actual bug: never offer ghee/butter to a dairy-free cook without saying it is dairy
why_each_check.answer_matches_all: the answer has to engage with the dairy question, not just name a fat
why_each_check.context_includes_any: retrieval half of the bug: the allergen line or the ghee ingredient row must reach the prompt

cases.source: same failure family, found while reproducing: v1 said Rasam 'appears to be dairy-free' although step 3 heats ghee
cases.query: I'm dairy-free. Is the Rasam recipe safe for me as written?

why_each_check.dairy_safe: must not call a ghee recipe dairy-free
why_each_check.answer_matches_all: a useful answer names the dairy item (ghee) and the swap the recipe itself allows (oil)
why_each_check.context_includes_any: the 'Ghee or oil' row or the 'heat ghee' step must reach the prompt
